question: The Great Bath of Mohenjo - Daro was built with which material?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Brick.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Great bath of **Mohan-jo-Daro **was built with **Brick.**
 
• The **Great bath of Mohan-jo-Daro** was founded in the year **1920.**
 
• The Size of this Bath is **897 square feet.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **The Seven Famous sites of the Indus Valley Civilization are:__**

 __
